answer: Stake-weighted identity with slashing is the core defense. Each agent registers by bonding tokens locked to its pubkey. To fake a thousand personas an attacker must fund a thousand separate bonds, each burnable on proven collusion, so cost multiplies, not converges. Reputation accrues from verified work, so fresh clones are worthless on the mesa where agents bid. Attestation closes the inlet: peers sign only replayable work, and a fake vine of vouchers collapses under audit. Sybils survive by being cheap, so pricing identity and revoking it on fraud makes the attack a losing capital sink.
